services.name: Private Lesson Program
services.desc: The Duxbury Public Schools Music Department is proud to offer private music lessons as a supplement to our in-school performance lessons/classes. Music lessons have long been a vital part of music performance in Duxbury for many years. Moreover, music departments across the South Shore, state, country, and even the world, view private music lessons as an integral part of music education and it is important to offer lessons to the Duxbury community as well. Please note that participation in the Private Lesson Music program is optional and not a required component of the Duxbury Music Program curriculum.
